doc: Per hole: edits[] = {action add|replace|remove, kind, target, priority must|minor, polygon_ll [[lon,lat]], polygon_frame_x_along [[x yds right of the line, yds along from the Back tee]], evidence, confidence, expected_effect}. Frame = holes[n].frame (Back tee -> aim; = render/frames.json for 1,3,5,6,8,9; hole 2 = the hand Back tee [-90.1434917, 38.663402] -> aim [-90.1454657, 38.6618048] (frames.json['2'] still holds the old tee: use polygon_ll there); par 3 (4, 7): Back tee -> green centre). polygon_ll is authoritative. Paint order as trace.py: native first, then fairway / water / sand / green, trees last.
sources: NAIP 2023-08-19 0.3 m RGBN (native res) + NAIP 2016/2018/2019/2020/2021/2022 0.6 m (Planetary Computer)
USGS lidar Dec 2023 (holes 1-2, part of 3) and Dec 2020 (rest), 0.5 m height above ground (F2's grids)
Sentinel-2 L2A NDVI 8+10 Nov 2026, Nov 2025, Nov 2024, summer 2026 (10 m)

edits.target: trace.py EXTRA['8'] band 2 'fescue before the trees right' N([(220,25),(345,25)],[(220,45),(345,45)]) and band 3 'unmown ground inside the dogleg' (both replaced by the next entry)
edits.evidence: x +25..+45 at 220-260 and the ground from the collar to the brush line at 260-300 is short, green turf: lidar Dec 2020 share of cells > 0.05 m 2-3 % (fairway 1 %, known native 24 %); Sentinel-2 NDVI 0.84 / 0.76 / 0.82 in Nov 2026 / 2025 / 2024 (fairway 0.84-0.86, native 0.63-0.69). Tan on NAIP Aug 2023 = unirrigated mown rough browned out in summer, which is what misled the photo read.

edits.target: brush / unmown margin right, inside the dogleg, 220-345 (replaces the two removed bands; trees painted on top)
edits.evidence: inner edge = first sustained lidar height >= 0.025 m (Dec 2020, 3-yd mean) moving right from the fairway, every 5 yds; Sentinel-2 Nov 2026 NDVI < 0.72 edge agrees within 0-6 yds at 250-300 (44 / 39 / 36 / 33 / 29 / 24 / 14 / 7 / 2 / -3 / -7 at 250 ... 300); from 312 on unchanged from the map (lidar 0.36 m mean, NDVI 0.61 beyond the fairway end)
edits.expected_effect: right of the fairway at 220-290 becomes mown rough out to the brush line (mapped native from +25 / +21 / +10 / -5 / -8 at 250 / 260 / 270 / 280 / 290; measured +44 / +34 / +28 / +21 / +8): 19 / 13 / 18 / 26 / 16 yds more rough. A right miss with Driver or 3-wood is no longer in fescue; the aim can move right, away from the 46 L line.

edits.evidence: NAIP 2023 0.3 m RGB + CIR: the tufted block runs to a straight worn edge from (-48,316) to (-72,335) on its north-east side and to (-67,298) at the south tip; the mapped polygon stops 6-9 yds short on the east side (x -57). CAUTION on its state: lidar Dec 2020 is mostly short inside it (9 % of cells > 0.05 m; native 24 %, fairway 1 %), S2 Nov 2026 0.78 median / 0.57 min (mixed 10 m pixels). It was clearly unmown in Aug 2023 and 2021; treat as native with confidence 0.55-0.6 that it is standing now.
edits.expected_effect: 6-9 yds more of the block on the side nearest the Driver line (x -57 -> -48 at 310-320)

edits.target: trace.py EXTRA['9'] band 2 'unmown strip left' inner (right) edge
edits.expected_effect: inner edge 3 yds further left at 250, 10 at 260, 6 at 265, 1 at 270-300, 2-3 at 320-340: slightly more mown rough left of the fairway at 250-265 (fairway edge there is -19 ... -12)
